title: item/1: one activity. `view` is all a learner may see; `key` holds the answer and never leaves the server side

form.description: parallel forms of a check or test (a, b, main, backup)

family.description: items made by one template share a family

supersedes.description: the item this one revises: the only way a reviewed item is replaced

provenance.description: who or what made the record; an AI-made record says so and cannot be reviewed by its maker

origin.description: human: written by a person; ai: drafted by a model; generator: produced by a deterministic program

maker.description: a public handle or an agent name; never an email address

by.description: who reviewed: for a human review that counts, a handle listed in REVIEWERS.json

kind.description: an ai review is advice. A jury review is the sourced AI jury of REVIEWERS.json: it counts only with its decision record (review/decisions/<id>.json), and only on a lesson or an item

role.description: subject: it teaches what it says and the answers are right; language: natural and right for the age and place; safety: nothing unsafe for a child; licence: every borrowed part may be used

decision.description: a jury review: the decision record that settles it
